_why_json: The framework (§12.5) names this file PRD-<nnn>.yaml. It is JSON because the repo declares no YAML parser, and a backlog is not a reason to add a dependency. Same data, same fields.
_how_to_read: Sprints are NOT written here: scripts/backlog.ts computes them from dependencies, priority and capacity, and renders docs/backlog/PRD-001.md. Edit this file, then run `npx tsx scripts/backlog.ts`; --check fails when the view is stale.

schedule._capacity_why: One human reviewer plus Witness, and at most 2 open agent PRs per reviewer (docs/PROCESS.md §7). Two tasks per lane per sprint because lanes are split by the files they touch (docs/MVP.md §3). An initial cap: recalibrate with the measured velocity after S1.
